title: Liquid Exposure Add-On on Moved-Down Cleaning Fees: Basis Q&A
content:
The fee assessed on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report that is moved down at review carries a liquid add-on read from the incident category and the reported trip's actual duration: a food or drink spill or bodily fluids on a trip whose actual duration reached the long-trip minutes (30 minutes) carries the liquid soak add-on of $25.00; a food or drink spill or bodily fluids on a shorter trip, or animal hair or mess or smoke or vape odor on any trip, carries the short-exposure add-on of $12.00; any other incident carries no liquid add-on.

**Where is the duration read?**
From the actual duration of the trip, in minutes, on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares). The incident category is read from the assessment.

**What does "reached" mean at 30 minutes?**
A trip of exactly 30 minutes has reached the long-trip minutes. A trip of 29 minutes is shorter.

**Does the duration matter for animal hair or mess, or for smoke or vape odor?**
No. Those categories carry the $12.00 short-exposure add-on on a trip of any length.

**Which incident carries no liquid add-on?**
Any incident outside the categories named above — among the cleaning categories, trash or debris.

**How does the add-on enter the fee?**
As a fixed dollar amount added to the fee assessed at the moved-down level.

## Summary table

| Incident category | Trip's actual duration | Liquid add-on |
|---|---|---|
| food or drink spill, or bodily fluids | 30 minutes or more | $25.00 (soak) |
| food or drink spill, or bodily fluids | under 30 minutes | $12.00 (short exposure) |
| animal hair or mess, or smoke or vape odor | any | $12.00 (short exposure) |
| any other incident, such as trash or debris | any | none |

**Boundary pair (hypothetical).** A drink spill on a 30-minute trip carries $25.00; the same spill on a 29-minute trip carries $12.00.
